android.desc:
Writing a list or starring a map won’t cut it. Organize and share your favourite shops, cafés, bars, restaurants, or anything you like.

COLLECT
See somewhere you love? Just snap.

We’ll store its location automagically, and you can categorize it however you choose.

CONNECT
Follow your friends – or just those with great taste.

Search any user and you’ll see all their public Collections. See something you like? One tap, and it’s in your library too.

DIRECTIONS ARE JUST A TAP AWAY.
You needn’t search everything in maps. Just tap ‘Get Directions’, and we’ll take you to where the spot was created.
